basic_profile.bio: Avid fan of animated shows, especially 'The Loud House'. I grew up in the UAE and currently work as a freelance graphic designer. I enjoy watching WWE matches and diving into conspiracy theories during my free time. I'm single and spend most of my online hours late at night when I can unwind from work and engage with my favorite online communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in graphic design, which I honed through a combination of formal education and self-learning via online courses and tutorials. I also have a keen interest in animated TV shows and professional wrestling, which I've followed closely for years.
